summary: D1 puts each project's ready tooling in one hand-authored manifest, .concord/tooling.v1.json, with required tier and independent cadence plus optional bounded cost_hint, config_path, automation_path, and notes; D2 aligns checker and schema text rules through raw string bounds and a required character outside JSON whitespace, validates shape without requiring adopters to vendor Concord's published schema, and proves that the manifest and referenced regular files remain inside the repository across symlinks; D3 holds the CD-0043 D1 boundary by carrying facts about tools and never methodology about when an agent should choose them; D4 performs file reads only so CD-0040 D6's probe-family limit holds and executing repository-named binaries stays unopened; D5 defines routine and on_demand as pure declared cadence intent, keeps automation_path informational, and rejects automation or CI text as cadence proof.
title: A project declares its ready tooling as a validated manifest
